messages.snippet: Dear Martin, Zoe, Our response mark-up attached (v3), tracked against your v2. Headlines: - General
messages.subject: Meridian / Harcourt – MSSA response (v3)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Martin, Zoe,

Our response mark-up attached (v3), tracked against your v2. Headlines:

- General cap: 150% of trailing 12-month fees.
- Data-protection super-cap: 300% of the annual subscription fee = £2,520,000 (this is Meridian's ceiling).
- Payment: 45 days.
- Renewal notice: back to 90 days.

We believe this gets us to agreed terms. Please confirm and we'll prepare the execution version.

Kind regards,
Elena

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
